/* Generated by web/scripts/build-i18n.cjs from public/locales.json. */
(function(root,factory){const api=factory();if(typeof module==='object'&&module.exports)module.exports=api;else root.JennyI18n=api;})(typeof globalThis!=='undefined'?globalThis:this,function(){
  'use strict';
  const catalog=/*CATALOG*/;
  function translate(key,language='it'){return catalog[language==='en'?'en':'it'][key] ?? key;}
  function create(language){return {language:language==='en'?'en':'it',t(key){return translate(key,this.language);},set(value){this.language=value==='en'?'en':'it';}};}
  function apply(root,locale){
    for(const node of root.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]'))node.textContent=locale.t(node.dataset.i18n);
    for(const attr of ['placeholder','title','aria-label','data-prompt'])for(const node of root.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-'+attr+']'))node.setAttribute(attr,locale.t(node.getAttribute('data-i18n-'+attr)));
    if(root.documentElement)root.documentElement.lang=locale.language;
  }
  return {catalog,create,translate,apply};
});
